title: Sensational news!
evenTitle: He said (that) he ... / He told me (that) he ...
evenTitleZh: 他（曾）说他……／他（曾）告诉我说他……

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.en: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
lines.zh: 您刚拍完一部新电影吗，马什小姐？

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.en: Are you going to make another?

lines.speaker: Miss Marsh
lines.en: I don't want to make another film for a long time.
lines.zh: 我早就不想再拍片子了。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.zh: 由本报记者艾伦·琼斯报导。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
lines.zh: 卡伦·马什今天到达伦敦机场。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
lines.zh: 她穿着一身蓝色的套装和一件貂皮大衣。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: She told me she had just made a new film.
lines.zh: 她告诉我她刚拍完一部新片子。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: She said she was not going to make another.
lines.zh: 她说她不准备再拍电影了。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: She said she was going to retire.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: She told reporters she felt very tired
lines.zh: 她告诉记者她感到很疲劳，

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.en: and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
